note: ADR-003 cross-record timestamp rules. Every record is validly signed and every digest link holds; the cases differ only in timestamps (offsets from the packet mandate's issued_at). broken_checks lists exactly the linkage checks that must be MISMATCH; chronology is the verifier's chronology status. covers maps the six reported scenarios (S1-S6) and the valid controls. The private key was discarded.

cases.name: observation-same-second-as-execution
cases.covers: valid control: observation and execution in the same recorded second

cases.name: execution-last-second-before-permit-expiry
cases.covers: valid control: authorised before the permit expired

cases.name: boundaries-equal
cases.covers: valid control: every inclusive bound equal

cases.name: pending-without-execution
cases.covers: valid control: pending chain (no execution yet)

cases.name: execution-at-permit-expiry-boundary
cases.covers: S2 execution exactly at the exclusive expiry boundary

cases.name: permit-issued-before-mandate
cases.covers: S5 permit issuance before mandate issuance

cases.name: permit-expiry-beyond-mandate-expiry
